method: reviewer-authored adversarial cases against the dispatcher module, disposable fixtures only, not the worker harness

attack_1_task_and_commission_binding.wrong_reason_masking: No masked-gate case found: each rejection reported the gate it was aimed at. The worker's own reported fix (sha-shape validation wrongly applied to task_id) is confirmed fixed -- validateAdjudication now uses requireNonPlaceholderText for task_id.

cases.case: no path to ACCEPTED without receipt
cases.observed: adjudicationState is the only ACCEPTED producer; deriveState maps a bare ACCEPTED event to the adjudication-required string

attack_3_git_terrain_and_publication.authority_source: changed paths derived by the dispatcher from git diff, not from caller metadata; caller-supplied path metadata has no authority in the gate
attack_3_git_terrain_and_publication.stale_remote_parent: publicationGate fetches the actual remote head immediately before publication and compares to the resolved base (STALE_REMOTE_PARENT). Not re-exercised against a live remote in this review (disposable local remotes only); code path inspected.

holds.observed: TORN_FINAL_RECORD surfaced; recover() blocking=true; append refused CORRUPT_EVENT_LOG
blocks to WRITER_LOCK_TIMEOUT (~10s), no silent concurrent write

findings.evidence: 6 concurrent OS processes racing SLOTS.worker=2 admitted 3 in 5/8 trials (harness2, max 4) and 3-4 in 7/12 trials (harness3, max 4); minimal reproducer admitted 3 in 3/12 trials. Worker's own evidence claims exactly 2.
findings.scope: submitTask admission path; any multi-process worker/reviewer concurrency
findings.root_cause: submitTask performs slotGate() and store.append() in two separate _withLock acquisitions; the capacity decision and the admission write are not atomic
findings.minimum_repair: single-lock admitTask that decides duplicate, enforces capacity and appends QUEUED inside ONE _withLock scope; plus a many-trial concurrency test asserting admitted == cap

findings.evidence: append({task_id,attempt,seq:1,state:'RUNNING'}) after append({..seq:1,state:'QUEUED'}) is deduped (appended=false); recorded states remain ['QUEUED']. A later RETURNED with the same seq is also dropped.
findings.scope: any caller that advances state without incrementing seq
findings.root_cause: eventKey = task_id|attempt|seq excludes state; the first event for a key wins permanently
findings.minimum_repair: include state in event identity, or allocate per-task monotonic seq inside the lock so callers cannot collide

findings.evidence: reclaim condition is `Date.now() - st.mtimeMs > 30000`; no pid liveness check. A live writer paused >30s is indistinguishable from a dead one.
findings.minimum_repair: record owner pid in the lock and reclaim only when the pid is dead

findings.evidence: append calls fs.fsyncSync(fd) on the log file; no fsync of the containing directory
findings.scope: crash-consistency claim; explicitly NOT a transactional-store claim
findings.minimum_repair: fsync the state directory after creating/rotating the log
